note: Official pages read by the collectors. adapter = name in collectors/src/registry.ts. runner = where it runs.

sources.notes: Covers callable retail FD (general + senior, each read off its own table's own date), non-callable ₹1,00,01,000–<₹3cr, and the discounted monthly-payout variant. No public bulk (≥₹3cr) page — the page says to contact a branch for interbank deposit rates.

Page pre-announces a slab change effective 2026-10-01 in a second table column. The adapter publishes the slabs in force today (dated 2026-04-23) as the current card, and additionally returns the pre-announced slabs as a second card dated 2026-10-01 with a note — do not activate that second card before its date.

General and senior are two separate single-column tables, each with its own plain-slab section and a "Special category" section of named peak tenures (12/400/600/900 days). No bulk (≥₹3cr) page was found; only the callable retail card is published.
Single flat 3.10% rate for Savings Bank Account, Basic/Suvidha Bachat, NRO and NRE alike — no balance slabs, and the page prints no effective date for this table.

Equitas's own dedicated RD table (same div-grid layout), not derived from the FD card.

esaf.bank.in (and the esafbank.com redirect) returned an Akamai 403 on every path from the build sandbox, incl. robots.txt, so robotsAllowed could not be checked. The adapter was built and tested against a fixture reconstructed from a search-engine cache of this exact URL (real header/row text, reasonable table markup — the live tag structure couldn't be inspected). Kept active because GitHub Actions/the VPS may reach the page where this sandbox can't; re-verify the table markup on the first live run. The page states RD rates equal the FD card's, so the RD card is derived via deriveRdFromFd and returned alongside the FD card by the same adapter (no separate 'esaf-sfb.rd' entry needed). No bulk (≥₹3cr) page was found.
Same access situation and reconstructed fixture as esaf-sfb:fd (see its notes). Every slab label restates "for incremental amount above Rs. X", so slabMethod is incremental.

Both suryoday.bank.in and the legacy suryodaybank.com returned HTTP 502 on every path from the build sandbox (incl. robots.txt) across two rounds ~20 minutes apart — looks like a WAF/CDN block on this sandbox's egress, not a real outage. The adapter was built and tested against a fixture reconstructed from a search-engine cache of this exact URL's "Savings Accounts" tab (real header/row text). Kept active for GitHub Actions/the VPS to try; re-verify markup on the first live run. FD and RD are NOT covered by any adapter here: every fetch or cache of the FD/RD product pages, and of this hub's other tabs, only ever showed a tenure-selector widget's single default-selected rate, never the full tenure table, on both domains — nothing safe to parse without guessing the other tenures.

One hub page renders every product as its own dated tab panel; the adapter scopes to each panel by its stable id so a date never leaks across products. Covers Domestic FD (general) and Platina FD (non-callable ₹1cr–<₹3cr, folded into the same 'fd' product). The legacy ujjivansfb.in domain times out on every attempt — always use the .bank.in domain. NRO/NRE/Tax Saver panels on the same page are out of scope for this pass.
Ujjivan's own dedicated RD panel/table, not derived from the FD card.
Savings panel is dated separately from FD/RD on the same page (05 Jun 2026 vs 01 Sep 2026 when this was built) — read independently per panel, never assumed equal.

The actual bulk (≥₹3cr) rates live in a separately-dated PDF whose filename embeds the publish date and changes often; the adapter discovers the current link from the stable hub page's own "Bulk Deposit Rates" panel on every run (via ctx.fetch) rather than hard-coding a dated URL. Publishes both Callable and Non-Callable rows across 4 amount bands (≥3cr–<5cr, ≥5cr–<20cr, ≥20cr–<50cr, ≥50cr).

Retail FD only (below ₹3 crore). Bulk (₹3cr and above): the PDF itself says 'contact the nearest branch', no public page. FD Plus (₹1cr-<3cr, non-callable) and the 5-year Tax Saver FD both point to their own rate card elsewhere on the site, but no genuine numeric copy of either was found — not covered. Verified against the live PDF 2026-09-27.

Own recurring-deposit card (not derived from FD). Earlier research on the same day saw this specific PDF carry a stale w.e.f. date (Jun 2024) while the FD annexure had already moved to May 2026 — the bank does not refresh every annexure at the same time. This adapter always reads the PDF's own w.e.f. line rather than assuming it matches the FD card; at verification time (2026-09-27) both PDFs showed the same May 05, 2026 date.
Incremental slabs, 'No Additional Interest Rate for Senior Citizen' per the page. Verified live 2026-09-27.

Own RD card (quoted by the bank as 'up to ₹2 crore'), same PDF as the FD card. Verified live 2026-09-27.

'Fixed Deposit Plus' and 'Bulk Deposits' are two headings on the same page for the identical non-callable ≥₹3cr tenure x crore-band grid; read once. No senior-citizen premium on this product per the page. Verified live 2026-09-27.
Own recurring-deposit card (different tenure buckets from FD). Verified live 2026-09-27.
Incremental slabs; above ₹20 crore the page says 'Contact Branch' (no rate published). Verified live 2026-09-27.

Own recurring-deposit card. Verified live 2026-09-27.

sources.notes: Unity republishes one dated 'website-disclosure-effective-DD-month-YYYY.pdf' bundling FD + Savings + Bulk together, with a new filename on every revision. This adapter discovers the current link from this stable FD product page each run (via ctx.fetch) rather than hardcoding a dated URL. Verified live 2026-09-27, discovered and read website-disclosure-effective-02-july-2026.pdf. See unity-sfb.history (not wired to a source here) for every reachable earlier version.

Callable + Non-Callable Bulk (≥₹3cr, 6 crore-bands) from the same discovered disclosure PDF. Callable senior rate is derived as general+0.50% because the bank states 'Senior citizen to receive 50 bps more for callable bulk deposits'; non-callable has no senior rate per the bank's own statement. Verified live 2026-09-27.
3 balance slabs from the same discovered disclosure PDF; slabMethod recorded as 'unknown' because the PDF does not state whole-balance vs incremental. Verified live 2026-09-27.

General-public rate only: the page states the senior (+0.50%, age 60+) and super-senior (+0.75%, age 80+) premiums as plain text, not as a printed column, so no per-row senior rate is published. The table's Non-Callable columns (minimum deposit >₹100 crore, printed as two successive dated revisions) are not read. Legacy iob.in is fully dead (404 on robots.txt and on the given rate-page URL, no redirect) — iob.bank.in is the only working domain.

Same page as the retail source; the Bulk Deposit table (≥₹3cr, callable + non-callable) is dated 'Interest Rate as on <today>' rather than a fixed revision date, so effectiveFrom will read as today on every run that shows no change to the underlying figures.

Not linked from the domestic-rates page's own navigation or from the /en/rates-at-a-glance index in this pass; found by trying the bank's own URL-naming convention directly (confirmed 200, and duplicated verbatim at /en/savings-bank-interest-rates). Two of the three slabs are repo-rate-linked and print the rate cell with the bank's own worked example, e.g. '2.20% (i.e. Repo Rate 5.25% minus 3.05%=2.20%)' — the adapter reads the leading percentage, not the worked example.

One page carries savings slabs and the domestic term-deposit table, whose own heading states it also sets the rate for NRO accounts, the Capital Gains Accounts Scheme 1988, the Recurring Deposit scheme and the Tax-Saver scheme — RD is derived from FD on that statement. No senior/super-senior column is printed (both premiums are page text, recorded in terms, not invented rows). No bulk (≥₹3cr) table was found on this page or discoverable from it in this pass. Legacy punjabandsindbank.co.in returns 502 on every path (broken host, not a redirect) — punjabandsind.bank.in is the only working domain.

PNB's page wraps its entire body in one ASP.NET <form>, which the shared trim-fixture.ts script's blanket <form> removal deletes wholesale (fine for a stray search box on other banks, fatal here) — flagged for the collectors/scripts/trim-fixture.ts maintainers, not fixed by this agent. Savings table also carries a rate history back to 03.05.2011 (~15 dated revisions); not captured as extra historical cards in this pass. RD was not covered: no explicit statement that RD equals the FD card rate was found on this page.

Landing page's 'Click here to Download' link is a session-tokenised downloadprocess.aspx?fid=... URL that changes on every republish; the adapter re-derives it from the landing page on every run via ctx.fetch rather than hard-coding a fid. It also re-fetches the deposit page above for the ₹3-10cr band and merges both into one fd_bulk card (effectiveFrom taken from the ₹3-10cr table). Only the PDF's Callable >₹10cr rows are read: unpdf's text extraction does not keep the Non-Callable >₹10cr table's tenure labels aligned with its rates, and a 5th, unlabelled column (PNB's NRE rate, only populated at exactly '1 year' — NRE's RBI-mandated minimum tenor) is out of scope. The same landing-page fixture needed a locally-built href-preserving trim (trim-fixture.ts keeps only rowspan/colspan attributes, which drops the <a href> this adapter reads) — also flagged for the trim script's maintainers.

One page carries savings, retail FD (<₹3cr, general customer only — additional interest for senior/staff/ex-staff is a separate text table, recorded in terms) and the ₹3-10cr/>₹10cr bulk tables. UCO's own 'UCO Sanchayika' RD product page states RD equals 'the bank's domestic card rate for normal term deposit (less than Rs.2 crore)' — note the ₹2 crore wording, narrower than the ₹3 crore retail band; the derived RD card's amount band is capped at ₹2 crore to match. Legacy ucobank.com returns 502 on every path (broken host, not a redirect).

Merges the ₹3-10cr table (callable + non-callable) with the three amount bands above ₹10cr (10-50cr/50-100cr/>100cr), each also callable + non-callable. The >₹10cr non-callable table genuinely stops at '>1Y to 2Y' in the source for all three bands — no rate is invented for longer tenors there.

Domestic/NRO term deposits (<₹3cr callable + ₹1-3cr non-callable) and savings slabs on one page. No senior/super-senior column is printed — the page states +0.50% (up to ₹5 crore) and +0.75% (deposits from 01.12.2022) as plain text, recorded in terms. Savings slab labels use the bank's own 'Crs' abbreviation, which the shared parseAmountBand misreads (its 'rs' strip also eats the 'r' out of 'Crs', turning e.g. '50 Crs' into bare '50 rupees'); worked around locally by expanding 'Crs' to 'Crore' before calling the shared parser — the bank-of-baroda adapter in this same repo hit the identical bug.

Static filename (unlike PNB's tokenised link) already refreshed daily by the bank (dated inside the PDF text). Reads the Callable and Non-Callable sections across 6 amount bands (₹3-10cr up to >₹500cr); the PDF's Notice Period Deposit section (not a tracked product) and NRE Callable Deposit section (different residency) are read but not carried into the card.

Both bankofindia.bank.in and the legacy bankofindia.co.in return HTTP 403 to every automated client tried (bankofindia.co.in 403s even on its plain homepage; bankofindia.bank.in additionally serves a Cloudflare 'checking your browser' interstitial) — confirmed on two attempts per domain with a browser User-Agent on 2026-09-27, and independently via Exa's own web-crawler cache hitting the identical challenge page. No genuine live HTML or JSON endpoint could be found anywhere. The adapter was written and tested against a Wayback Machine snapshot of the bank's own page (captured 2025-07-09), per the brief's rule that a cache of the bank's OWN page may be used to build/test a parser but never as the live source — kept inactive until a browser-capable runner (GitHub Actions or a VPS with Playwright) can confirm it against a real render. The archived copy only exposed the general-public rate; a SENIOR CITIZEN tab referenced in the same page's markup was not present as static HTML.

A plain curl (even with a full browser User-Agent) reliably gets a Radware/ShieldSquare 'Captcha Page' from every www.federal.bank.in URL, but this project's own fetchDoc (Node fetch/undici) reached the real page repeatedly while building and live-checking this adapter on 2026-09-27 -- likely a TLS/HTTP client fingerprint difference, not an absolute block. Fixture is a genuine trim of that live response. No bulk (>=Rs 3 crore) source is listed: the 'HVD Web Interest' PDF's href IS discoverable on this page, but fetching that specific document (a different /documents/10180/<folderId>/... path than the one that works) returns Radware's block page even via fetchDoc -- a gap to retry from GitHub Actions/VPS, not a guess.

Same client-dependent Radware behaviour as federal-bank:fd (see its notes) -- fixture is a genuine trim of a live fetchDoc response from 2026-09-27. The Rs 50 crore-<Rs 200 crore slab is deliberately left out of the parsed result: its own published sub-rates don't reconcile with the slab's own balance range (see reconcileNestedRates in federal-bank.ts) -- a real inconsistency on the bank's own page (it repeats a 'for balance less than Rs 10 crore' sub-clause inside a slab that starts at Rs 50 crore), not something we should guess at.
Verified against a live fetch (2026-09-27, HTTP 200, real table markup). One combined page also carries the bulk, RD and savings tables used by the other hdfc-bank.* adapters below.

Verified against a live fetch of both the HTML page and the JSON it points at. No bulk-deposit source: no dedicated >=Rs 2-3 crore domestic FD rate page or JSON endpoint was found on icici.bank.in (a guessed /fixed-deposit/bulk-deposits URL 404s); the FD JSON also carries 8 additional undocumented tabs (interestData[1..8]) beyond the retail one used here, with no amount/tab label found for any of them, so they are not used rather than guessed at.
Own dedicated JSON API (distinct from the FD one — RD has narrower tenure bands), discovered from the page the same way as FD.
Flat 2.50% across all balances (no slabs) as of this fetch, read directly from the HTML table (no JSON API involved for this page).

Verified against a live fetch. One page also carries the >=Rs 3 crore tables used by indusind-bank.bulk below. No RD source: the dedicated Recurring Deposit page has zero <table> elements (a single marketing headline number only), and the bank does not state RD=FD anywhere found, so it's a gap rather than a guess.
Only Rs 3-5 crore (callable + non-callable) is on this page; no table was found for >=Rs 5 crore (the page instead says those rates are quoted per-deposit and valid only the day of booking).

sources.termsNote: Slabs below Rs 5 crore are incremental; the bank's own footnote says slabs from Rs 5 crore up are 'Flat Rate applicable on entire balance' (see each slab's note). Bands above Rs 1400 crore are MIBOR-linked with no fixed percentage printed and are not included.
sources.notes: Verified against a live fetch.

Every rate table is a PDF whose dated file name changes on revision without the old URL ever redirecting or 404ing (it just stops being linked), so this source is the stable 'Interest Rates' index page; the adapter discovers the current Retail Deposits PDF link from it each run (via cheerio, not regex — one link's label has an un-escaped '>' that breaks naive <a> regexes, see idfc-first-bank.ts) and fetches that PDF with ctx.fetch. The same PDF also carries an explicit RD table (not derived from FD) plus Tax Saver and Green Deposit rows, all folded into this one adapter's output.

Discovers and parses the current Bulk Deposits PDF (Rs 3 crore and above), sections (I) and (II) only (Rs 3-27.50 crore, non-callable and callable). Sections (III)/(IV) for amounts above Rs 27.50 crore (ten narrower sub-bands, abbreviated 'crs.' labels, inline '<=' ranges) are not parsed — a follow-up, not a guess, given how few depositors reach that size.

sources.termsNote: The bank calls its slab method 'progressive'; its own worked example (Rs 10 lakh balance: 2.50% on the first Rs 3 lakh, 7.00% on the remaining Rs 7 lakh) is the domain model's 'incremental' method.
sources.notes: Discovers the current Savings Deposits PDF from the index page. The index page's plain HTML savings-account link is a decoy for this purpose (same product, different/older content) — the adapter only follows links whose href ends in .pdf.
